director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj hum kisi shape ke chaaron taraf ka poora kinaara naapenge. Chalo, shuru karein?
pata nahi

Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon. Cricket pitch ke kinaare kone se chalkar wahin lauto: yahi parimap hai. Isi tarah triangle ka bhi niklega. Is triangle ki teen bhujayein hain, 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm. Ek kone par ungli rakho aur kinaare par chalao: pehli bhuja, doosri, teesri, aur wapas usi kone par. Ungli jitna chali, wahi parimap hai. Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?
director.card: Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?

seams.form: Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon.

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao
Board par triangle ki har bhuja par uska naap likha hai. Ungli jin bhujaon se guzri, un sabke naap milakar socho. Is triangle ki bhujayein 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm hain; iska parimap kitna hai?
director.card: Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao

Haan, ise aur aasaan karke samjhaati hoon. Socho is triangle ka kinaara ek dhaage se bana hai. Ek kone se dhaaga khol ke seedha kar do: 4 cm, phir 5 cm, phir 6 cm, sab ek line mein. Us seedhi line ki poori lambai hi parimap hai. Is triangle ki bhujayein 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm hain; iska parimap kitna hai?
director.card: Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?

seams.form: Haan, ise aur aasaan karke samjhaati hoon.

director.text: 15 cm hai na

Sahi jawab, kyunki 4 + 5 + 6 = 15 cm, teeno bhujayein judi, koi nahi chhooti. Yeh hexagon hai, chhah bhujaon wala. Sab bhujayein barabar hain, par label sirf ek par hai: 5 cm. Baaki par kuch likha nahi, phir bhi woh kinaare mein aati hain. Parimap mein har bhuja aati hai, likhi ho ya na ho. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: pata nahi
Ungli ko hexagon ke kinaare par ek poora chakkar ghumao, aur har bhuja par uski lambai jodte jao. Is hexagon ki ek bhuja par 5 cm likha hai; poore hexagon ka parimap kitne cm hai?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: 30 centimetre

Haan, sahi hai: chhah bhujayein, har ek 5 cm ki: 6 × 5 = 30 cm. Ab yeh rectangle dekho, 6 cm lamba aur 4 cm chauda. Parimap ek dhaaga hai jo kinaare par chalta hai: pehle 6, phir bagal ki bhuja 4, phir 6, phir 4. Andar ki jagah area hai, woh bilkul alag cheez hai. Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?
director.card: Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

director.text: 20 cm hai na

Bilkul sahi, kyunki dhaaga sirf kinaare par chalta hai: 6 + 4 + 6 + 4 = 20 cm. Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain. Maali ke paas 35 m baad hai. Phoolon ki kyari triangle jaisi hai, bhujayein 8 m, 9 m aur 14 m. Kinaare-kinaare ek baar baad lagani hai. Poori baad lagane ke liye kitni bhujaon ka naap jodna hoga?

seams.form: Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain.

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Yahan kyari ka kinaara khol kar seedhi line bana di hai. Maali ke paas 35 m baad hai. Poori baad lagane ke liye kitni bhujaon ka naap jodna hoga?
mujhe nahi pata

Socho baad ki jaali teen roll mein aayi hai: ek 8 m, ek 9 m, ek 14 m. Har bhuja par ek roll khulta hai, toh poori baad teeno roll milakar banti hai. Poori baad lagane ke liye kitni bhujaon ka naap jodna hoga?
haan

Baad kinaare par lagti hai, toh har bhuja par lagegi: teeno par: 8 m, 9 m aur 14 m, kyunki ek bhi bhuja chhooti toh wahan khaali jagah reh jaayegi. Ab jod lo: 8 + 9 + 14 = 31 m, kyunki kyari ke poore kinaare par itni baad lagegi. Tumhari baari: maali ki 35 m baad mein se kitni bachegi?
director.card: Tumhari baari: maali ki 35 m baad mein se kitni bachegi?

director.text: mujhe nahi pata
35 m mein se jitni baad kyari par lag gayi, utni hata do; jo reh gayi, wahi bachi. Kyari par 31 m baad lagi; maali ki 35 m mein se kitni bachegi?
director.card: Tumhari baari: maali ki 35 m baad mein se kitni bachegi?

director.text: 18 m sahi nahi hai. Isko ek naye dhang se dekhein. Khet ke kone P par ungli rakho, aur har bhuja ka naam lekar uski lambai jodo. Jod tab poora, jab ungli wapas P par ho. Khet PQRST: PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m, TP 3 m. Poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?

Haan, pehle tum try karo.
director.card: Khet PQRST: PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m, TP 3 m. Poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?

director.text: Sahi jawab, kyunki P se wapas P tak paanchon bhujayein: 8 + 5 + 7 + 6 + 3 = 29 m. Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. Kyari par 31 m baad lagi; maali ki 35 m mein se kitni bachegi?

director.text: 18 m nahi, yeh jawab theek nahi baitha. Socho tum kyari ke ek kone par khade ho. 8 m chalo, mudo, 9 m chalo, mudo, phir 14 m chal ke wahin pahunch jao. Baad utni hi lagegi jitna tum chale; maali ki 35 m mein se baaki bachegi. Kyari par 31 m baad lagi; maali ki 35 m mein se kitni bachegi?

director.text: Haan, sahi hai: maali ki baad kyari ke poore kinaare se 4 m lambi thi. Toh poora jawab: maali ke paas 4 m baad bachegi. Ek park ki chaar bhujayein alag-alag lambai ki hain. Ek kone se ghoomo toh: 9 m, 6 m, 7 m aur 4 m. Usi kone par wapas pahunchne tak kitne metre chaloge?
director.card: Ek park ki chaar bhujayein alag-alag lambai ki hain. Ek kone se ghoomo toh: 9 m, 6 m, 7 m aur 4 m. Usi kone par wapas pahunchne tak kitne metre chaloge?

director.text: 22 m sahi nahi hai. Kone se chalo aur har bhuja ki lambai jodte jao; chakkar tabhi poora hai jab chaaron bhujayein jud jaayein. 9 m, 6 m, 7 m aur 4 m bhujaon wale park mein ek kone se ghoom ke wapas usi kone tak kitne metre hote hain?

director.text: Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 26 m hai, kyunki chaaron bhujayein judti hain: 9 + 6 + 7 + 4 = 26 m. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
chauka
Achha, toh tumhe chauka sabse achha lagta hai. Ab apni padhai par lautte hain. Zoya ne 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka parimap 10 × 4 = 40 cm nikala. Sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?

director.text: 40 cm

40 cm sahi nahi hai. Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Socho, rectangle ke kinaare par dhaaga lapeta, phir khol ke scale par rakha: woh lambai parimap hai. Andar tiles bichhao toh area. Parimap mein bhujayein jodte hain, guna nahi. Tumhare paas 140 cm ribbon hai. 14 cm lambe, 9 cm chaude sticker ke kinaare-kinaare ribbon lagao. Kitna bachega?

14 cm nahi, yeh jawab theek nahi baitha. Ribbon andar nahi jaata. Pehle dekho kinaare par kitna lagega, phir use 140 mein se ghatao. 140 cm ribbon mein se 14 cm lambe, 9 cm chaude sticker ke kinaare-kinaare ek baar lagaane ke baad kitna ribbon bachega?

director.text: 14 cm

14 cm se baat nahi bani. Is rectangle ko ek chhota aangan socho: deewar kinaare par chalti hai, aur andar farsh hai jo area hai. Deewar ki lambai ke liye bhujayein jodte hain; lambai aur chaudai ka guna sirf farsh batata hai. Ab phir se socho, jawab kya hoga?

director.text: 94 cm hai na

Sahi jawab, kyunki kinaare par 14 + 9 + 14 + 9 = 46 cm lagega, toh 140 − 46 = 94 cm bachega. Theek hai, ab wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain. Zoya ne 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka parimap 10 × 4 = 40 cm nikala. Sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?
director.card: Zoya ne 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka parimap 10 × 4 = 40 cm nikala. Sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?

director.text: 28 cm

Haan, sahi hai: parimap kinaara hai: 10 + 4 + 10 + 4 = 28 cm; 10 × 4 andar ki jagah hai. Seedhi bhujaon wali har shape mein har bhuja jodna chalta hai. Ab ek rectangle socho: iski bhujayein jodiyon mein aati hain, aur isse jodne ka ek jaldi wala tareeka milta hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
haan, samajh aaya

Is rectangle ki do lambi bhujayein 10 m ki hain, woh lambai hai. Do chhoti bhujayein 6 m ki, woh chaudai. Aamne-saamne ki bhujayein barabar hoti hain. 10 aur 6 ek-ek baar likhe hain, par chakkar lagao toh dono do-do baar milte hain. Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?
director.card: Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?

director.text: 16 m sahi nahi hai. Ek doosri tarah se samajhte hain. Socho, ek cheenti khet ke kone se chalti hai. Woh lambai, phir chaudai chali, toh saamne wale kone par hai: aadha chakkar. Shuru wala kona do bhujayein door hai. Cheenti 19 m lambe aur 8 m chaude khet ka ek poora chakkar lagati hai. Woh kul kitne metre chali?
director.card: Cheenti 19 m lambe aur 8 m chaude khet ka ek poora chakkar lagati hai. Woh kul kitne metre chali?

seams.form: Ek doosri tarah se samajhte hain.

director.text: Bilkul sahi: do lambai aur do chaudai: 19 + 8 + 19 + 8 = 54 m. Chalo, ab pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain. 10 m lambe, 6 m chaude is rectangle ka ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hai?
director.card: Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?

director.text: 16 m nahi, yeh jawab theek nahi baitha. Ungli ek kone se ghumao: har mod par ek bhuja khatam hoti hai, aur chaar mod ke baad tum wahin pahunchte ho. Ab phir se socho, jawab kya hoga?
director.card: Ek poora chakkar kitne metre ka hua?

director.text: 32 metre

Sahi jawab, kyunki 10 aur 6 dono do-do baar aate hain. Naya rectangle: 12 m lamba, 5 m chauda. Neeche baayein kone se chalo, 12 m aage, phir 5 m upar. Ab tum saamne wale kone par ho, yaani aadha chakkar. Baaki aadha bhi utna hi lamba hai. Isliye parimap = 2 × (lambai + chaudai). Is rectangle ke liye 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna banta hai?
director.card: Is rectangle ke liye 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna banta hai?

director.text: 17 m se baat nahi bani. Formula mein bracket pehle: usmein lambai aur chaudai jaati hain. Phir bracket ka do guna. Toh ab batao, kya aayega?
director.card: Is rectangle ke liye 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna banta hai?

director.text: samajh nahi aaya

Is rectangle ki chaar bhujaon ko do jodiyon mein baanto: ek 12 m aur ek 5 m ki jodi, aur waisi hi doosri jodi. Ek jodi ka jod lo aur uska do guna karo: yahi 2 × (lambai + chaudai) hai. Is rectangle ke liye 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna banta hai?
director.card: Is rectangle ke liye 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna banta hai?

director.text: phir bhi samajh nahi aaya

Ek kone se saamne wale kone tak do raaste hain, ek neeche se aur ek upar se. Dono mein ek lambai aur ek chaudai hai, isliye dono barabar, aur dono milke poora chakkar. Is rectangle ke liye 2 × (lambai + chaudai) kitna banta hai?

director.text: 34 m hai na

Haan, sahi hai: aadha chakkar 12 + 5 = 17 m, aur uska do guna: 2 × 17 = 34 m. Ab ek square lo: uski chaaron bhujayein barabar hoti hain, yahan har ek 6 cm. 6 ko chaar baar jodne se achha, seedha 4 × bhuja. Jawab kinaare ka naap hai, toh centimetre mein aayega, square centimetre mein nahi. Ek bhuja 6 cm hai, toh chaaron bhujayein milkar kitne cm hain?
director.card: Ek bhuja 6 cm hai, toh chaaron bhujayein milkar kitne cm hain?

director.text: 36 cm

36 cm sahi nahi hai. Isko ek naye dhang se dekhein. Socho, kinaare par dhaaga lapeta aur scale par naapa: woh kinaara hai. Andar ke 1 cm wale square gine: woh area hai. Kinaare ke liye bhujayein jodo. Ek bookmark 11 cm lamba, 2 cm chauda hai. Uska poora kinaara kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: Ek bookmark 11 cm lamba, 2 cm chauda hai. Uska poora kinaara kitne centimetre ka hai?

22 cm nahi, yeh jawab theek nahi baitha. 11 × 2 andar ke square centimetre deta hai. Kinaare ke liye bookmark ki chaaron bhujayein socho. 11 cm lambe, 2 cm chaude bookmark ka poora kinaara kitne centimetre ka hai?

22 cm se baat nahi bani. Ek chocolate ke wrapper ko socho: uske kinaare ki sunehri line scale se centimetre mein naapte hain, aur andar ki chocolate ke chhote square gine jaate hain. Line ke liye bhujayein judti hain; guna sirf andar ke square ginta hai. Ab phir se socho, jawab kya hoga?

Haan, sahi hai: chaar bhujayein, har ek 6 cm: 4 × 6 = 24 cm, kinaare ka naap hai isliye cm. Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain. Ek notebook ka cover rectangle hai, 24 cm lamba aur 18 cm chauda. Uske kinaare par ek baar tape lagani hai. Kone se saamne wale kone tak, aadhe chakkar mein kaun si bhujayein aati hain?

director.text: bas aaj ke liye itna hi
Theek hai, koi baat nahi. Hum aage chal sakte hain, thoda break le sakte hain, ya aaj ke liye stop kar sakte hain. Tum batao.
